headline: Saginaw Valley State start conference play as top scorers
dek: Saginaw Valley State's win over Davenport took them past Northern Michigan as the conference's top scorers: sixteen goals from nine different players, with five conceded. Three wins and two draws leave them alongside Roosevelt and Purdue Northwest as the sides yet to lose.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring is top-heavy: Saginaw Valley State alone have scored more than Davenport, St. Cloud State and Wisconsin-Parkside together.

wire.line: Nine different players have now scored for Saginaw Valley State, who are unbeaten and top scorers after the conference opener.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, the earliest of them Northern Michigan's opening match against Green Bay.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Roosevelt's five wins are more than any other programme has managed.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Matty Telfer has scored seven of Saginaw Valley State's sixteen goals, from thirteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cedrik Strupler has saved nineteen shots and conceded one goal for Roosevelt, a save percentage of .950.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Davenport have now conceded sixteen goals and scored four, and the defeat at Saginaw Valley State was their third of the season.

last_match.line: Roosevelt are still unbeaten and have more wins than any other side; Wisconsin-Parkside have lost more often than they have won.

next_match.line: Saginaw Valley State have yet to lose and won when these sides met earlier this month; Northern Michigan have alternated wins and defeats all season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
